component.name: Voltaic
component.summary: Wireless device battery levels in the system tray

description.p: Voltaic shows the charge of Logitech keyboards and mice, and of AirPods down to each earbud and the case, in a translucent panel anchored to a tray icon. Hover the icon for a gauge per device; click to keep it open.
It speaks Logitech's HID++ over /dev/hidraw and Apple's accessory protocol over an L2CAP socket directly, using only the Python standard library. Solaar is not required, and neither is root.

ul.li: Per-earbud AirPods battery — left, right and case separately, rather than the single blended figure BlueZ offers
Works with Unifying, Bolt and Nano receivers, and with Logitech devices paired directly over Bluetooth
Remembers devices that go offline, with their last known charge
Live updates between scans, from unsolicited HID++ notifications

screenshot.caption: The panel, with a gauge per device
Bluetooth accessories that are away keep their last levels

description.p: A signed apt repository, a manual page, and software-centre metadata.
One-command install on every major distribution.
Application icon, tests, CI, and an install that works on distributions enforcing PEP 668.
